mapper.select: SELECT ifnull(GROUP_CONCAT(t2.name SEPARATOR '-'),"(未分组)") as name FROM ( SELECT @r AS _id, ( SELECT @r := pid FROM ky_category WHERE id = _id ) AS pid, @s := @s + 1 AS sort FROM ( SELECT @r := #{alarmAreaId}, @s := 0 ) temp, ky_category WHERE @r > 0 ORDER BY sort DESC ) t1 JOIN ky_category t2 ON t1._id = t2.id
mapper.update: update ky_category set has_child = #{status} where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select id as "key", name as "title", (case when has_child = '1' then 0 else 1 end) as isLeaf, pid as parentId from ky_category where pid = #{pid}
and ${key} = #{value}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT @r AS _id, (SELECT @r := pid FROM ky_category WHERE id = _id) AS parent_id, @l := @l + 1 AS lvl FROM (SELECT @r := #{locationId}, @l := 0) vars, ky_category AS h WHERE @r != 0 ) t1 JOIN ky_category ky ON t1._id = ky.Id ORDER BY t1.lvl DESC
